title: A two-categorical Snake Lemma
summary: We prove a Snake Lemma for 2-categories. Working in a 2-category with a strong bizero object, we develop 2-kernels and 2-cokernels, 2-monomorphisms and 2-epimorphisms as fully faithful and cofully faithful 1-cells, short 2-exact sequences and normal image factorisations, and we prove a two-dimensional Normal Short Five Lemma. We then introduce the dinversion of an antinormal pair and the notion of a homologically self-dual 2-category, characterised equally by the self-duality of homology, by a Pure Snake Lemma and by a Third Isomorphism Property.
